og.title: Contact HeatEx Direct
og.description: Contact HeatEx Direct about heat exchanger sourcing, manufacturer profiles, product pages, content partnerships, or supplier information corrections.

hero.title: Tell us what you are looking for
hero.subtitle: Whether you are an industrial buyer, a Chinese heat exchanger manufacturer, or a potential content or market partner, this is the place to reach our team.
hero.description: We prioritize messages related to heat exchanger sourcing, manufacturer profile updates, product page additions, industry news leads, content partnerships, and platform corrections. Clear context helps us decide the next step faster.

reasons.title: Send the right context, and the conversation moves faster
reasons.description: These are the most common reasons to contact us. If your request is a concrete project inquiry, the structured RFQ page may also be the right starting point.

inquiry.title: Buyer sourcing questions
inquiry.description: Looking for plate, welded plate, shell-and-tube, air cooler, packaged unit, or spare-parts suppliers? Share project context, equipment type, and key operating conditions.

profile.title: Manufacturer profile updates
profile.description: If your company is already listed, contact us to update company descriptions, product scope, media, certificates, export markets, or contact details.

partnership.title: Supplier partnerships and visibility
partnership.description: Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers can ask about improving English profiles, adding product pages, uploading files and images, or submitting article drafts for Industry News.

feedback.title: Profile corrections and missing data
feedback.description: Found an issue with a company name, product description, image, certificate, link, or public source? Send the page link and the correction you recommend.

media.title: Industry news and article leads
media.description: Send us Chinese heat exchanger market news, manufacturer updates, technical article ideas, exhibition information, or product update leads for editorial review.

other.title: Other platform questions
other.description: For language versions, page access, email verification, directory inclusion, privacy, or general platform questions, email us with the relevant details.

cta.title: Start with one clear email
cta.subtitle: For project inquiries, include basic operating conditions. For profile updates, include the company name and page link.
cta.note: We read messages manually and route them to the relevant person for sourcing, profile data, or content partnerships.
checklist: Your role: buyer, engineer, EPC, distributor, manufacturer, media contact, or partner.
For sourcing needs, include equipment type, application, media, temperatures, pressure, materials, quantity, and target market.
For profile updates, include company name, website, page link, fields to update, and any available files.
For articles, news, or content partnerships, include the topic, source material, image files, and the cooperation direction you have in mind.
